message.content: Jane Kim (D) for California Insurance Commissioner is endorsed by CAIR Action, AROC Action, and Ro Khanna, and supported by Vote for Peace at the Ally tier. Vote for Peace reports Kim pledged to reject war-lobby support and favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide. In contrast, Ben Allen (D) is opposed by Vote for Peace and endorsed by Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, Asian Americans for Good Government, and Pilipino American Los Angeles Democrats. Allen supported deleting anti-Israel language from California Democratic Party resolutions in 2019, opposes BDS, and supports Israel's right to exist and defend itself. In 2023 he visited Kibbutz K'far Aza, framing the conflict around October 7 and antisemitism, and he cited support for SCR 105 calling for an end to Gaza's humanitarian catastrophe and release of all hostages.
